heading: The landscape video editor is part of 3Speak Pro

landscape.title: Landscape video editor
landscape.body: Edit 16:9, 4:3 and square videos. The Shorts and audio editors stay free.

uploads.title: Publish as often as you like
uploads.body: No daily limit on publishing videos and Shorts, and no daily cap on audio uploads.

longAudio.title: Audio longer than 20 minutes
longAudio.body: Free audio uploads stop at 20 minutes.
